# Test fixtures

Every artist, title, album and ISRC in these files is **fictional** and was invented for
SOMM's test-suite (ISRCs use the `QZ` prefix and made-up registrant codes). No real
catalogue metadata is copied here. Provider responses in the tests are hand-written mocks
shaped like the documented API responses; they prove SOMM's handling of those shapes, not
that a live provider is reachable.
